content_scope.include: 期权教育与策略内容；若页面主体是期权，也包括期货期权（options on futures）。
content_scope.exclude: 不涉及期权的纯期货教育、交易或产品内容。
content_scope.roles: Apify 只采集可引用的教育正文。CME Institute 与 Cboe Options Institute 是教育源，不是 Market Data / DataShop。OptionStrat、Option Alpha、Optionistics Screener 是产品对标，不是行情源；其报价与 /build 空壳不得当知识抓取。

sources.name: Cboe Options Institute
sources.notes: Education only: independent text or PDF pages. Course catalogs and interactive lessons are not knowledge-eligible. Cboe DataShop and LiveVol market data are not crawled here.

sources.name: Option Alpha
sources.notes: Public education text only. Not a market-data or trading API. Course landings are catalog-only. Bot trigger/condition/action belongs in product-pattern notes, not strategy cards.

sources.name: CME Institute
sources.notes: CME Institute education pages only (options on futures when the page is about option contracts). The CME Market Data API is not crawled through this allowlist.

sources.name: Investopedia
sources.reason: Terms and robots.txt prohibit automated scraping and AI dataset construction; retain links only, not crawled content.

sources.name: Optionistics
sources.notes: Learning Center lesson pages and glossary only; skip TOCs (including /s/tutorial), screeners, and calculators. Delayed quotes and screener tables are not a market-data source for this vault.

sources.name: Options Profit Calculator
sources.notes: FAQ is stable. www /calculator/* nav shells are skipped and must not be approved as knowledge. www2 calculator pages already ingested stay as secondary structure evidence only; profit-and-loss numbers stay with OIC.

sources.name: OptionStrat
sources.notes: Product-benchmark tutorials only. Not a market-data API. Do not crawl /build/* stubs. Do not copy calculator numbers onto named strategy cards.

sources.name: Share Predictions
sources.notes: Public FAQ/product copy only; not used as strategy-card evidence.
